tree.help_text:
symguard — local-first security gateway for AI agents

Usage:
  symguard <command> [flags]

Commands:
  version   Print version and build info
  doctor    Check system health and configuration
  decide    Read a JSON decision request from stdin, write the decision to stdout
  grants    List and revoke standing grants
  scan      Discover MCP servers across supported AI clients
  help      Show this help message

Run 'symguard <command> --help' for details on a specific command.

Usage:
  symguard decide < request.json

Reads one JSON decision request from stdin and writes the JSON decision
to stdout:

  request:  {"command": "...", "risk_class": "low|medium|high|critical",
             "domain": "...", "warnings": ["..."]}
  response: {"decision": "allow|confirm|deny", "reason": "..."}

Any error produces decision "deny" with an explanatory reason.

Usage:
  symguard grants list
  symguard grants revoke <id> | --all

Commands:
  list      List active grants
  revoke    Revoke a grant by ID, or revoke every grant with --all

Run 'symguard grants <command> --help' for details.

Usage:
  symguard grants list
  symguard grants revoke <id> | --all

Commands:
  list      List active grants
  revoke    Revoke a grant by ID, or revoke every grant with --all

Run 'symguard grants <command> --help' for details.

Usage:
  symguard scan [--format table|json]

Discovers MCP servers across supported AI clients (hermes, claude-desktop,
cursor, vscode, opencode). The inventory is written to stdout; findings —
clients or entries that could not be mapped — are written to stderr.

probes.host_dependent_reason: Go doctor exit/report depend on the host: on Windows a missing client-config parent directory is ERROR_PATH_NOT_FOUND, which discovery.containsNotExist does not treat as missing, so the empty-HOME probe exits 1 with an `mcp servers error` row (Unix: exit 0); the Windows bytes are derived from the Go source, not a recorded Windows capture.
